pageSubtitle: Screen breaks, move breaks, company quests, and group quests — mix it up.
weeklyRecapSubtitle: On the Board — Move MVP, Quest MVP, points, and arcade for this week.

moveBreak.title: Move break
moveBreak.whyBody: Interns already live on screens. This quest is honor-system and short on purpose — no GPS, no step counter. Just get up, move a little, come back sharper.

groupQuests.heading: Group quests
groupQuests.createGroupDescription: Choose teammates who can assign quests to one another. You can create as many groups as you need.
groupQuests.chooseTeammatesHint: Leave empty to include everyone in the room. You are always included.
groupQuests.noTeammatesYet: No other teammates yet — Create group will still make a group with just you. Invite people to the room to add them later.
groupQuests.groupExistsError: A group with that name already exists.
groupQuests.questPlaceholder: e.g. Share a win from this week
groupQuests.noQuestsEmpty: No group quests yet. Be first to post one.
groupQuests.tipText: Tip: create a group or ask a teammate to add you so you can assign quests.
